brief.title: Your work agent. Not on your laptop.
brief.text: It searches the tools you use and answers with its sources, even on a schedule.

approval.title: Nothing changes until you approve.
approval.text: Every change to your tools, shown exactly as it will run.

new-chat.title: Every tool you use. One agent.
new-chat.text: Slack, Drive, Dropbox, Basecamp, and many more.

schedules.title: Hand it the morning brief.
schedules.text: Each run starts a new chat as you, and you hear when it's ready.

projects.title: Shared with your team.
projects.text: Each person's connected accounts stay their own.

chats.title: Hosted in Germany.
chats.text: Models run in the EU. No index of your company: it searches live.
